programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: The guys outfit a UTV Chase Truck to make sure their Race UTV can make it to the finish line.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a vintage C-10 with a few modern conveniences.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Don’t miss this episode of Truck U, when Matt and Bruno transform a modern Jeep LJ into a vintage Cj-8 scrambler.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: See what it takes to rebuild a Turbo in a 7.3L Diesel on this episode of Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we’re going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That’s why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican’s old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: It’s time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

programme.desc: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1970 Plymouth Superbird work is resumed, and the 1970 Charger R/T collision repair is completed. The 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 383 2bbl. V8 is assembled and painted.

programme.desc: Automotive parts supplier Tony D'Agostino of Tony's Parts helps the shop get organized, and Mark tests his Mopar knowledge against Tony's. Work on a 1970 Plymouth Superbird is completed.

programme.desc: The 1970 Superbird's restoration and story is recapped, and the Hills visit the shop to take delivery of the car, along with its original owner. Mike and Michael Hill drive the Superbird on a cross county trip home to South Carolina.

programme.desc: With the 1970 Plymouth Superbird done and safely driven home, Mark is asked to restore a 1969 Daytona Charger. Due to its condition, Mark questions if it's practical and if it's even legal.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Just when things couldn't get more stressful, Mark agrees to finally get the 1930 Chevy Coach fully restored by the end of the week. Meanwhile, Mark QC's the next cars in the process of resurrection.

programme.desc: See the complete 3-year restoration of Kimberly Cook's 1970 Barracuda Convertible: the body, paint, engine, and convertible top, culminating in Graveyard Carz' most emotional reveal to date.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: New shop. New crew. An All-new Graveyard Carz! The ghouls tackle a 1970 Cuda.

programme.desc: Mark paints a Hemi Charger in his favorite Mopar color, burnt orange. AMD delivers the Phantom Cuda, and the ghouls finish the Dailey's 1970 Cuda 383, a project four years in the making.

programme.desc: The ghouls wrap up the 340 Cuda and install panels on the Hemi Charger. Mark trains Allysa on O.E.M. assembly line markings. The legendary red Plymouth Fury "Christine" visits the shop.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.desc: The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin go under the hood of the new Mustang EcoBoost 4-cylinder to add some performance upgrades. Meanwhile, progress on an old pickup project continues with rust repair and new body panels.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: When a 1969 Camaro with bad body roll is delivered to the shop, Kevin and Willie tackle the suspension to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie build a new bed for an ongoing 1973 truck project before solving some issues with the hub assembly on a hefty F-350.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Federated Auto Parts send Willie B. and Kevin a Jeep Wrangler to outfit with a new Dana 44 and a few other upgrades for a lucky winner.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: With a powerful Dodge Challenger in the shop for maintenance and performance upgrades, Kevin and Willie can’t resist adding on a new exhaust for the owner as well.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: When Willie and Kevin find a 1953 M37 sitting in a friend’s garage next to a Cummins 4BT and all the parts needed for an engine swap, they volunteer to provide the labor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have a sweet 1970 Chevelle in the shop with a worn-out interior and a problematic cowl induction system seal. Plus, Kevin tackles the daunting task of rebuilding an infamous Rochester Quadrajet Carburetor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Willie stumbles across a beautiful 1966 Impala, but its beauty is only skin-deep. Under the hood are rusty headers, a grimy engine block, and a host of other needed repairs. It’s up to Willie and Kevin to restore this classic to its former glory.

programme.title: Truck U

programme.title: Truck U

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have an Autobahn edition 2013 MK6 VW GTI in the shop for performance upgrades. With a new turbo kit, exhaust, and a few other improvements, the guys plan to boost this car’s status from “daily driver” to “head-turner.”

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads. Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: If you’re headed for the formidable Moab Desert, your Jeep had better be ready for anything. Willie and Kevin are outfitting a Wrangler TJ and a Cherokee XJ to handle the harsh environment of the desert.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin hits the road to Bolingbrook, Illinois to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America”, as he tours WeatherTech to see how they make all those great American products.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have a Mini Cooper S in the shop today. They add some horsepower, some stopping power, and fix up a worn-out suspension to improve handling. Then they see if they can even fit in it for the test drive!

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have a problematic Trailblazer in the shop today. They tackle multiple issues and get it up and runnin’ again. The guys also kick start a performance build project on a Gen5 Camaro!

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: A lace bra and knicker set tests the sewers before they turn thermals into daywear. They must then fit a pair of luxury pyjamas to their male models. One sewers wins Garment of the Week, and another is asked to leave the Sewing Room

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The quarter finalists go back to the 1930s to take women’s sailor trousers. They also turn men’s shirts into 1930s women’s blouses and fit glamorous bias-cut evening gowns reminiscent of outfits worn by Katherine Hepburn and Bette Davis.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes the four semi-finalists into the Sewing Room to celebrate the influences of Japanese design and sewing. The Sewers follow the patterns for a kimono inspired dress, mend old denim using Japanese techniques and create an outfit using folding and pleating

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final, and the sewers take on a trio of party themed challenges. They start with the pattern for Esme’s iconic Amorphous dress, use old scraps to make a party outfit and fit red-carpet-worthy jumpsuits. The judges have the difficult task of deciding who will be crowed by Britain’s best sewer

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Sara Pascoe welcomes 12 new sewers to the Sewing Bee. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young test the sewers with ‘Classics with a Twist’. The sewers make a top with a twist, transform the office uniform into a new look to reflect their style and create a dress that has cut out details to fit their models.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s not exactly a holiday for the sewers, as judges Patrick and Esme task them with creating garments based around a travel wardrobe. They’re asked to create a rucksack and a swimsuit and to transform windbreakers. Who will make a splash, and who will take a nose dive and leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: The ten remaining sewers celebrate clothes from west Africa. Guest judge Nigerian fashion designer Banke Kuku joins Esme and Patrick this week. Who will impress all three judges and win Garment of the Week, and who will become the third sewer to leave the competition?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Taking on the fashion industry, the second most polluting industry in the world, it’s Reduce, Reuse and Recycle week. The sewers attempt a zero waste pattern for a pair of trousers, transform several bags in to a garment and source second hand crochet blankets to create new outfits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Art week as the remaining sewers tackle three challenges inspired by the world of art. The sewers make a skirt inspired by the modernist movement, transform canvases into dresses, and draw on artists’ dreams to create fantastical outfits for a mind bending catwalk.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Kids week in the sewing room, and Sara Pascoe invites the seven remaining sewers to make a child’s dragon dressing gown. In the transformation challenge, the sewers personalise denim jackets using hand-me-downs. Finally mini models have fancy dress outfits created ready for the party.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Its week 7 and we’re going back to the 90s with cargo pants, 90s icon fancy dress and body skimming supermodel dresses. Who will make it into the quarter final, and who will take a tumble on the catwalk and leave the sewing room?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s week 8, and the remaining sewers celebrate fashion icons with little black dresses, a shower curtain transformation and smoking jackets. Who will secure icon status and win Garment of the Week, and who will be a fashion fail?

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the semi-final, and this week it’s three utilitarian clothing; the trench coat, housework garments and boiler suits.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: It’s the final of The Great British Sewing Bee, and the sewers face three challenges including a Victoriana dress, fabulous men’s outfits and a two-in-one dress. Past contestants return for a reunion, while the judges decide who will be crowned this year’s best amateur sewer.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Kiell Smith-Bynoe welcomes the 12 sewers as we kick off the tenth series. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young set the challenges. The Pattern challenge is a denim A-line midiskirt, they’re asked to transform t-shirts and the made to measure is to create a casual day dress to fit their models.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The six teams tackle two miniature classics, strawberry tarts and fruit salad, before reinventing the retro pineapple upside-down cake. As always, they face two days of testing challenges judged by two world class patisserie experts, Benoit Blin and Cherish Finden

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The five remaining teams make the classic layered dessert millefeuille, master the art of illusion, and create a bird-themed pièce montée adorned with Paris-Brest. The pressure and the difficulty of the challenges is ramping up with every week that the teams stay in the competition.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: This week the judges have a surprise up their sleeves with a challenge never before seen on Baking ShowThe Professionals in the shape of a secret challenge for the teams. Which of the teams will rise to the challenge and which will fall at this first chocolate challenge?

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: Six new teams make tarte chiboust vallée d'Auge and rice puddings, before reinventing the Key lime pie, complete with breathtaking towering edible sculptures, for their showpiece. Judging their efforts are world class Patissier Chefs Benoit Blin and Cherish Finden.

programme.desc: The remaining sewers celebrate divas past and present. Judges Patrick Grant and Esme Young use Tina Turner’s iconic fringed dress as inspiration for the pattern challenge. programme.desc: It’s the semi final and three challenges inspired by design icons . Firstly, the sewers recreate a Christobal Balenciaga dress. Mary even has a trick for cooking steak ahead of time which guarantees perfect results.

The star of the show is slow roast shoulder of lamb with rosemary and paprika rub, served with potato and fennel gratin. For pudding Mary serves plum tarte tatin and a delicious fruit salad.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: This time Mary Berry is cooking dishes for a family celebration. With recipes for beef and mushroom stew with mustard mash, salmon en croûte with a foolproof salad, and chocolate and orange panna cotta. Mary’s meringue tranche with berries and cream is guaranteed to impress your friends and family

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: Mary’s Mediterranean platter of houmous, bread sticks, roasted vegetables and a tomato and mozzarella salad is perfect food for sharing. For hungry guests Mary offers lamb dhansak and a a pasta dish that takes just 15 minutes to make.

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: In this final episode Mary shows us recipes for a summer party. programme.desc: Find baby animals in their cutest moments—eating, napping, bathing, and playing, making each moment delightful

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Winter"
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "India’s Lost World"
programme.desc: Northeast India is an anthropological paradise; there is no other place on Earth with so many different ethnic groups. The forests are filled with mysterious tribes whose lives are dictated by the rain and the seasonal fruits of the forest.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Thar Desert : Sacred Sands"
programme.desc: Covering 125,000 square miles, India's Thar desert is one of the harshest places on Earth. Desiccating winds and a near-permanent drought has earned this unforgiving land another name: the region of death.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Ganges: River of Life"
programme.desc: The Ganges is the longest river in India. It flows from the glaciers of the Himalayas all the way down to the Bay of Bengal. It's a lifeline to wild animals, from rhinoceros and river dolphins to otters and gharial crocodiles.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "The Himalayas: Surviving the Summits"
programme.desc: The Himalayas run across 1550 miles of north India. The Himalayas' rugged highlands offer little direct refuge to humans, and in the shadow below, over a billion people in India rely on the mountains for survival.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Robbie"
programme.desc: Howdie and Dawn are working dogs and their owner wants them to mate, but neither are interested so Stacey intervenes, Mark treats a horse with a very sore leg and Stacey operates on sushi the cat who has skin cancer.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Willow"
programme.desc: Willow’s leg is lame and Stacey decides to amputate, Jack the Jack Russel has been kicked out of doggy school and Stacey tries to help and Mark changes Shadow the cat from a male into a female.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Terraforming: Can We Build A Planet B?"
programme.desc: Once we’ve managed to get a handle on building structures to help us live on the harsh, dangerous surfaces of other celestial bodies -- why stop there?

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Speedskating"
programme.desc: Speed skater Beorn Nijenhuis and presenter Julien Kang visit laboratories to ask how does technology help to make the difference between silver and gold?

programme.title: Breaking Limits S1 - "Snowboarding"
programme.desc: How do innovators and athletes work together to beat the competition on the slope and the half pipe?

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
programme.desc: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Treadmills, Turntables and Barbeques"
programme.desc: Treadmill, turntable, barbeque, outboard motor, pneumatic drill, ballpoint pen... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Cross Trainers, 3D Printers and Turnstiles"
programme.desc: Cross-trainer, 3D printer, food mixer, frozen yoghurt maker, turnstile and office chair... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: How Things Work S1 - "Elevators, Gas Pumps and Air-Hockey Tables"
programme.desc: Elevator, gas pump, air-hockey table, wood chipper, deli meat slicer and dentist drill... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Motor Homes"
programme.desc: Francesca finds out for herself just how good today’s mobile homes can be . She visits one UK company who specialise in producing top of the range vehicles.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Wooden Houses"
programme.desc: Francesca visits two companies making wooden houses. One makes flat pack homes for assembly and the other specialises in creating beautiful wooden frames.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Guitars"
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando is in the UK to visit custom electric guitar makers Crimson Guitars and the iconic Marshall Amplification factory in Milton Keynes.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Prodrive"
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando hits the racetrack for a test drive in one of the fastest motorsport cars in the world, a hand-built Prodrive Aston Martin.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Aviation"
programme.desc: The way we fly about to change, driven by a new breed of aviators not afraid to think differently. Could the days of the jet age be numbered?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programme.desc: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"
programme.desc: The power of the ocean's tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth. Teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flowers of water.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "MV Thermopylae"
programme.desc: One of the largest vehicle carriers battles bad weather and industrial action while racing to transport up to 8,000 cars.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "MV Helgafell"
programme.desc: A reinforced vessel braves rough winter seas to transport fresh salmon from remote North Atlantic fish farms to Rotterdam.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Crown Princess"
programme.desc: While 3,000 guests vacation, 100 engineers work around the clock to generate enough power to run this giant floating hotel.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "One Columba"
programme.desc: A massive 360-meter container ship faces dangerous navigation challenges through narrow river channels and ancient ports.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Royal Clipper"
programme.desc: Engineers use modern hydraulics to sail the world’s largest square-rigged ship while keeping high-end cruise guests comfortable.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Saipem 7000"
programme.desc: The world's second-largest crane vessel faces tense delays and closing weather during a multi-million-dollar oil rig job.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Typhoo Tea and Fox's biscuits"
programme.desc: In search of the classic British pairing, tea and biscuits, Lord Prescott travels to Liverpool to visit the Typhoo tea factory, discovering the key to a perfectly brewed cup. Back in Yorkshire, he stops by the Fox’s biscuits factory, rounding off his journey with a truly British treat.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Trains"
programme.desc: A fascinating look at the radical concepts and innovative ideas that are making trains faster, safer and ever more futuristic.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Strike Planes"
programme.desc: Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 2"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel takes on the final records attempts, and the shocking results leave everyone reeling.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Pathfinders"
programme.desc: Pathfinders are elite paratroopers trained to go behind enemy lines, lead air insertions, gather intelligence, and execute high-risk, deadly missions.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Elite Forces"
programme.desc: Elite Forces are specially trained soldiers who carry out extreme, high-risk missions anywhere in the world, anytime they’re needed.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programme.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
programme.desc: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"
programme.desc: Stealthy diesel submarines challenge nuclear subs. Inside a NATO exercise, we explore why they’re so deadly in the Norwegian fjords.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Heavy Armor"
programme.desc: Tank crews train for deployment, mastering modern armored warfare where heavy tanks protect soldiers and dominate the battlefield.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Snipers"
programme.desc: Silent and deadly, snipers train in elite schools, mastering long‑range weapons, stealth, and fieldcraft to become the battlefield’s ultimate asset.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Urban Warfare"
programme.desc: Urban combat is brutal and unforgiving. At training sites worldwide, soldiers learn the tactics and teamwork needed to survive deadly city battles.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Fighter Pilots"
programme.desc: New pilots train in air‑to‑air combat at an international exercise, mastering dogfighting and modern fighter jet technology.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Paratroopers"
programme.desc: Airborne troops train as force multipliers, learning how paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to seize targets and launch ambushes.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Medics"
programme.desc: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Biomimicry/Mechanimals"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he explores how designers are using Manta Rays to change the way we explore the ocean’s depths.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Robots For Hire"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he talks to astronauts, designers and factory workers as they describe how the robotic revolution is affecting the way we work.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Food"
programme.desc: Host Joe Penna talks to the people who are creating the foods of the future and samples everything from test tube beef to edible insects.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "They Cyborgs Are Coming"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he discovers a search and rescue robot that doubles as a tank, cuddles a therapy robot designed to look, and act, like an actual pet, and tests a high tech fireman’s mask that has a lot more than X-ray vision.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Future of Crime Fighting"
programme.desc: Host Joe Penna talks to designers who’ve created a robotic security guard.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Medicine"
programme.desc: Host Joe Penna examines electronic skin that keeps tabs of your vital functions and warns of trouble.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Wearable Tech"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as meets a colorblind man who, thanks to a revolutionary piece of technology, has become a well-known visual artist who ‘hears’ colors.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Future Living Spaces"
programme.desc: Host Joe Penna goes on a voyage of discovery that takes him to underwater homes, and even homes built in tiny parking spots.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Outer Space"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he talks to pioneers in the future of space.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Driving"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he discovers where this invention is headed in the run-up to 2050.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of 3D Printing"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he meets pioneers in the field of 3D printing.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of The Oceans"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he visits with developers who are turning to the ocean as a renewable source of power.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Entertainment"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he visits with people creating operas—with robots.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Alien Worlds"
programme.desc: A virtual scalpel dissects methane lakes and icy crusts to reveal hidden oceans and water-erupting volcanoes on distant moons.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Asteroids"
programme.desc: By stripping the crust and peeling back craters, CGI exposes the hidden minerals and refueling potential locked inside these asteroid worlds.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programme.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programme.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Water"
programme.desc: In India's Ladakh, rising temperatures are leading to glacial melt and water shortages in the mountains of the Himalayas. The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan is also sturggling as it experiences severe drought.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Air: Changing the Atmosphere"
programme.desc: Every year seven million people die from air pollution. It's the world's biggest environmental killer.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Food"
programme.desc: In South Africa and Nepal, earthrise looks at food production solutions being developed to help with adjusting to new conditions.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Shelter"
programme.desc: In Colombia and Singapore, earthrise looks at sustainable forms of shelter.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Land Gaining Ground"
programme.desc: Earthrise looks at methods of land restoration and conservation as human causes and climate change wreak havoc.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Survival"
programme.desc: As the US no longer stands to be a global climate leader, China takes the mantle.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Antarctica On The Edge"
programme.desc: Earthrise sets off on a month-long journey around Antarctica to study the effects of climate change on the continent.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"
programme.desc: Earthrise assesses the depth of the crisis facing the world’s grasslands today, and explores some of the solutions that are being used to preserve them.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Astronauts"
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Shore to Shore"
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA on Mars.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Declaring Martian Law"
programme.desc: Space is home to crucial resources, important discoveries, and big potential profit.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 1)"
programme.desc: We take you behind the scenes for an exclusive look at the inner workings of one of America’s biggest air shows.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )"
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to the two-part special including an up-close look at the U.S. Navy Blue Angels.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programme.desc: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive flyer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programme.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programme.desc: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft ownership"
programme.desc: Kurtis explores the varied costs and entry points of flying for everyone from the weekend warrior to the rich and famous. When your driveway is a runway, life is good… and as airparks go, this place is Heavenly! Are two engines really better than one?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programme.desc: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programme.desc: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Wind"
programme.desc: This film follows the race to generate vast power from thin air - the wind. One of the world's biggest windfarms is being built off the English coast.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Aviation"
programme.desc: The way we fly about to change, driven by a new breed of aviators not afraid to think differently. Could the days of the jet age be numbered?

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Fusion"
programme.desc: It is the greatest technological challenge ever undertaken by humankind. The quest to produce the ultimate energy solution... fusion.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Tidal"

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Maritime"
programme.desc: Shipping companies and engineers are creating new machines to make their industry greener using a resource that has moved man across oceans for thousands of years... winds.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Solar"
programme.desc: The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system. Innovators are searching for new ways to capture more of the sun's power.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Venice"

programme.desc: CGI animation strips down the Windy City, uncovering the deep foundations and structural engineering required to build on unstable marshland.

The match reaches a "Freestyle" peak with aggressive "inside out rolls" and fierce hands battles at the net, capturing the raw emotion of a rivalry where teams are willing to "cut down the nets" for national glory.

programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. The stakes are higher than ever as the top two drivers in the series—Blake Granger and Armando Castro—face off in a high-pressure JCB Racing matchup that could shift the season leaderboard. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. Witness the passion and raw power as these elite athletes push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge for the Wichita crowd.

programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

programme.title: Brothers of the West

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: Red Ryder helps his old friend Dan O'Connor in his fight against Faro Savage and his gang of rustlers.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: An ex-lawman infiltrates an outlaw gang to avenge the death of his brother.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: A youth from Gabby Whittaker's (George "Gabby" Hayes) Half-a-Chance Ranch for boys from troubled homes becomes a pawn in the fight between his late father's gang and Roy Rogers.

programme.title: Hands Across the Border
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Captain Apache
programme.desc: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

programme.desc: Extremely remote adventures on FishON! this season. Back to our roots with walleye fishing in Northern Ontario

programme.title: Stoked On Fishing
programme.desc: If you've never been to Alaska, it is an absolute must-see. Alaska is amazingly unique. If you have been there before, you know what we are talking about. Last week Shea McIntee and the crew settled in at Alaskan Anglers Inn, headed out fishing, and hooked onto their personal best halibut. This week Stoked on fishing heats up with round two, getting into some solid Halibut and Black Bass, finish the day winding down with a delicious dinner and some jacuzzi time. Stoked on Alaska. Here we go!

programme.title: Catching Bass | Tiny Topwater Fun
programme.desc: Dustin fishes a finesse topwater bait for bass in Early Summer

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. This trip was absolutely nuts, with the best Blue Fin Tuna fishing we have seen in Sothern California all year.

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We prepared some very entertaining clips from the Nürburgring for you. Expect to see the pedal on the metal and rubber burning.

programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships.
